artist.name: Katelyn Tarver
artist.short_description: Katelyn Tarver — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring indie pop.
artist.biography: Katelyn Tarver is an American singer-songwriter and actress raised in Glennville, Georgia. Her recording history reaches back to the 2000s; she later appeared in television productions including Big Time Rush. Music biographies describe her songwriting work for other performers and the growth of an adult alternative-pop sound in her own releases. A major early point of recognition was the song ‘You Don't Know’ in 2017. She went on to release Subject to Change in 2021 and Quitter in 2024. Her 2026 album Tell Me How You Really Feel adds a new autobiographical focus. In a direct interview, Tarver described the record as documenting the emotional consequences of ending a long marriage and rebuilding her sense of identity. This broader explanation establishes the album's context, but should not automatically be assigned as the intended meaning of every song on it. At Afterglow, she connects emotional-pop songwriting with questions of identity, self-doubt, honesty and change. That positioning is an editorial assessment of her documented career and subject matter.
